text:
Renee: Heads-up  FinLayer POC asks for a minimal assurance packet so their security team can greenlight a trial. They want: SOC2 storage/network excerpt, a signed pen-test letter, a presigned EU-only upload (36h), and a straight answer on Dedicated burst billing. Can we split?
Diego: I can pull the SOC2 controls and add a 1-line plain-English summary. Should we include control IDs?
Renee: yes include control IDs + highlight anything prod-only. They insisted uploads must stay in eu-west-1.
Marta: Legal needs vendor name, scan scope, and POC contact to sign the pen-test letter. Also will confirm whether we can extend presign beyond 24h. @Luke can you confirm vendor?
Luke: vendor = NightwatchSec. contact = sec@finlayer.io. scope = external webapp + one staging subnet. They asked for a 36h presign window (unusual) and auto-delete in 5 days.
Marta: 36h presign OK if we note retention and get SalesOps sign-off on cost exposure. I will draft the letter with one-line limitation: "no customer key access".
Diego: I'll redact hostnames and replace IPs with placeholders. Adding EU residency blurb and evidence index.
Renee: presign preferred. Marta, once signed can we issue 36h?
Marta: yes, I'll countersign once Diego confirms redactions.
SalesOps: For Dedicated bursts: short bursts are allowed but billable. Quick guidance: uplift ~16% for short bursts on A10g class; exact quote requires committed baseline. Send numbers and I'll post a line-item.
Renee: baseline = 5 x A10g reserved for 72h, expecting 3h/day burst for 4 days.
SalesOps: will calculate and post a concise estimate.
ComplianceBot: Reminder: do not export raw logs. When shipping SOC2 excerpts externally include a redaction + retention note and certify EU residency for uploads.
Diego: SOC2 excerpt prepared and redacted. Replaced hostnames and removed production-only diagrams. Uploading excerpt to thread.
Marta: drafting pen-test attestation: "NightwatchSec performed an external web application and staging network scan during the POC window. Redwood attests that no customer keys or secrets were accessed." Will sign after Diego confirms redaction.
Diego: redaction confirmed.
Marta: signed attestation uploaded (PDF).
Renee: Luke/Marta can you also confirm the presign command you'll run? I want the exact CLI for audit.
Luke: Will run: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-eu-proofpacks/finlayer/poc-bundle.zip --region eu-west-1 --expires-in 129600`  (129600s = 36h). Will include encryption and restrict ACL.
Marta: Legal OK with 36h presign and 5-day auto-delete. Note in the package: uploads will be deleted automatically after 5 days; contact security@redwood.com for exceptions.
SalesOps: Posted burst uplift estimate: approx +16% uplift -> estimated additional cost ~$1,100 for requested burst profile. Attaching quick calc.
Renee: assembling the minimal assurance packet and sending to sec@finlayer.io now along with a one-pager "what we share / what we don't".
Renee: Sent. Customer replied: "Can you confirm presign is EU-only and that deletion is irrevocable? Also can we get a signed pen-test letter with signatory name?"
Marta: Presign uses an EU bucket (eu-west-1). Deletion scheduled and irreversible by default; we track retention logs. I signed with my name (Marta Cole) as authorized counsel; attaching signed PDF.
Renee: Customer starting upload. Closing this thread when upload completes. Thanks team :thumbsup:
